name: Apify
description: Discover and run Apify Actors, then retrieve scraped datasets and results.
examples: Find an Apify Actor that can scrape Google Maps listings
Run the Instagram profile scraper and show me the follower counts
Fetch the results from my last Apify Actor run
long_description: Use the Apify plugin to discover Actors in the Apify Store, run them with custom input, poll run status, and retrieve scraped data from datasets and key-value stores in your connected Apify account. Running an Actor consumes your Apify compute credits, so the assistant confirms with you before starting any run.
